root_cause: This project carries a project-wide ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES ... GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS TO anon. A "revoke all on function ... from public" therefore does NOT remove the direct anon grant created at CREATE time, so every function added after the 20260803214145/20260803214253 hardening pass arrived anon-executable. Documented in 20260803020100_provider_request_security_revoke_anon.sql:3-16 and 20260803214253:1-8.

leaked_password_protection.detail: Supabase Auth HaveIBeenPwned check is disabled on staging. It is an Auth configuration flag, not a database object, so it cannot be set through SQL or through any tool available to this pass (no Management API token is present in this environment and the Supabase MCP surface exposes no auth-config mutation).
leaked_password_protection.required_owner_action: Supabase Dashboard -> Project yzqjvdfgefveprobvvyw -> Authentication -> Policies -> enable "Leaked password protection"; or PATCH /v1/projects/yzqjvdfgefveprobvvyw/config/auth with {"password_hibp_enabled": true} using a Management API token.
